stories.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
stories.simple_summary: A judge said Apple can see OpenAI's hiring records and private messages as part of a legal case. OpenAI had hired some people who used to work at Apple, and Apple wants to check if OpenAI stole any of their secrets.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to lawyers and people invested in these companies. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Why AI could end the price tag as we know it
stories.simple_summary: The headline suggests AI might change how prices are shown in stores, but the article excerpt is missing so I cannot explain the details confidently.
stories.why_it_matters: I cannot tell you what this means without reading the full story.

stories.title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is allowing people to use AI to remake old video games and put them on new devices. You can now take an old game and add new features to it, like taking an old recipe and making changes to cook it a different way.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to gamers and game creators. Most people won't be affected.

stories.title: Melania Trump launches nationwide 'Super Intelligence' challenge for K-12 students
stories.simple_summary: Melania Trump started a contest encouraging kids in school to work on artificial intelligence projects. Students can participate and show what they can build.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in school, they might hear about this competition. Otherwise, it's mainly relevant to educators.

stories.title: Flox Intelligence is building AI to keep wildlife away from trains, airports, and roads
stories.simple_summary: A company created AI machines that listen for animal sounds and play noises to scare animals away from train tracks, airports, and roads. Think of it like an automatic dog whistle that protects wildlife and keeps them safe.
stories.why_it_matters: This helps prevent animals from getting hit by trains or planes, but it won't directly affect most people's daily lives.

stories.title: Facebook is giving users more control over their algorithm
stories.simple_summary: Facebook is giving you more say in what posts you see on your feed. You can tell it which topics you like more, and it will show you more of those instead of guessing what you want.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Facebook, you'll have an easier time seeing the things you actually care about instead of content that doesn't interest you.

stories.title: Opinion | The future job market will break career ladders. Find out who could fall.
stories.simple_summary: This opinion piece suggests that AI will change how careers work in the future. Some workers might find it harder to climb the traditional career ladder.
stories.why_it_matters: Without reading the full article, I cannot tell you which workers might struggle. This is worth reading if you have kids or grandkids starting careers.

stories.title: I don’t miss the camera on the Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses
stories.simple_summary: A writer tested Ray-Ban glasses that have built-in speakers and removed the camera from them. The glasses let you listen to music and take calls without a camera.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a product review. It only matters if you're interested in buying these specific glasses.

stories.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
stories.simple_summary: A company uses AI to test self-driving cars and robots in computer simulations before they go on real roads. It's like practicing a recipe on a test batch before cooking for a party.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and car companies. It makes self-driving cars safer, but this is still mostly an engineering story.

stories.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
stories.simple_summary: Companies are worried about security problems because AI tools let employees do things the company didn't expect. A security company raised money to help businesses protect themselves from these new risks.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business and your workers use AI tools, you should think about whether your company data is safe.

stories.title: Facebook will let you customize your feed algorithm using AI
stories.simple_summary: Facebook added a tool called 'Your Algorithm' that lets you pick which topics show up most in your feed. You can say you like certain subjects more, and Facebook learns from that right away.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Facebook, you now have better control over what you see instead of Facebook deciding everything for you.

stories.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android
stories.simple_summary: Google made it simpler for people to build AI-powered apps just for themselves or their friends without sharing them with the whole world. It's like baking a cake for your own kitchen instead of opening a bakery.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly for software developers and tech enthusiasts. Most people won't be affected unless they want to build their own apps.
